title: I don't ... (present simple negative)
summary: Отрицание в present simple: **don't** (I/we/you/they) и **doesn't** (he/she/it) + глагол в начальной форме.
ru:
## Как сказать «не делаю»
Для отрицания в present simple нужен вспомогательный глагол **do**: **don't** или **doesn't**, а после него — глагол **в начальной форме** (без -s).
> I **don't like** coffee. — Я не люблю кофе.
> She **doesn't like** coffee. — Она не любит кофе.

## Какую форму выбрать
- **don't** (= do not) — с **I / we / you / they** и множественным числом
- **doesn't** (= does not) — с **he / she / it** и одним человеком или предметом
> We **don't watch** TV very often. — Мы нечасто смотрим телевизор.
> My car **doesn't use** much petrol. — Моя машина не расходует много бензина.
> Gerry and Linda **don't know** many people. — Джерри и Линда мало кого знают.

## Главное правило: -s пропадает
В отрицании **-s уже стоит в doesn't**, поэтому к глаголу его не добавляем.
> He plays tennis. → He **doesn't play** tennis. (не ~~doesn't plays~~)
> She has a car. → She **doesn't have** a car. (не ~~doesn't has~~)
> Tom does his homework. → Tom **doesn't do** his homework.

## С be — по-другому
С глаголом **be** (am / is / are) do не нужен: **I'm not, he isn't, they aren't**.
> I **am not** tired. (не ~~I don't am tired~~)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I no like coffee.~~ → I **don't like** coffee.
- ~~He don't like football.~~ → He **doesn't like** football.
- ~~She doesn't likes music.~~ → She **doesn't like** music.
- ~~Fred don't know me.~~ → Fred **doesn't know** me.
- ~~I don't have breakfast usually.~~ → I **don't usually have** breakfast. (слово частоты перед глаголом)
en:
## How to make a negative
In the present simple we use **do / does + not** (**don't / doesn't**) and the **infinitive** (the base form of the verb, with no -s).
> I **don't like** coffee.
> She **doesn't like** coffee.

## Which one?
- **don't** — with **I / we / you / they** and plural nouns
- **doesn't** — with **he / she / it** and singular nouns
> We **don't watch** TV very often.
> My car **doesn't use** much petrol.
> Gerry and Linda **don't know** many people.

## Important: no -s on the verb
**Doesn't** already shows he / she / it, so the main verb has no -s.
> He plays tennis. → He **doesn't play** tennis. (not ~~doesn't plays~~)
> She has a car. → She **doesn't have** a car. (not ~~doesn't has~~)

## With be
With **be** we don't use do: **I'm not, he isn't, they aren't**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I no like coffee.~~ → I **don't like** coffee.
- ~~He don't like football.~~ → He **doesn't like** football.
- ~~She doesn't likes music.~~ → She **doesn't like** music.
structure:
## Отрицание
| Подлежащее | do not | Глагол | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | **don't** (do not) | work, like, have | I don't work. They don't like tea. |
| he / she / it | **doesn't** (does not) | work, like, have | He doesn't work. It doesn't rain. |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **don't / doesn't** + глагол (начальная форма)
> I **don't know** his name. · She **doesn't speak** French.

## Сравните
| Утверждение | Отрицание |
|---|---|
| I like fish. | I don't like fish. |
| He likes fish. | He doesn't like fish. |
| She has a dog. | She doesn't have a dog. |
| He does yoga. | He doesn't do yoga. |

## Со словами частоты
> I **don't** often watch TV. · She **doesn't** usually eat meat.
> **never** уже содержит отрицание, don't с ним не нужен: I **never** eat fish. (не ~~I don't never eat~~)

## Краткая и полная форма
- don't = do not · doesn't = does not

items.text: They {{don't|do not}} know my phone number.
The weather is nice. It {{doesn't|does not}} rain much here.
We {{don't|do not}} watch TV very often.
My brother {{doesn't|does not}} play the piano.

exercises.title: Сделайте предложение отрицательным
exercises.instruction: Напишите пропущенную часть отрицательного предложения (**don't / doesn't + глагол**).

items.text: I play the guitar. → I {{don't play|do not play}} the guitar.
Jane plays the guitar. → Jane {{doesn't play|does not play}} the guitar.
They know my address. → They {{don't know|do not know}} my address.
He has a bath every day. → He {{doesn't have|does not have}} a bath every day.
You do the same thing every day. → You {{don't do|do not do}} the same thing every day.
She speaks Italian. → She {{doesn't speak|does not speak}} Italian.

items.q: We ___ live in a big house.

items.why: С be — **am not**, don't не используется.

exercises.title: Сделайте предложения отрицательными
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение в отрицательной форме. Используйте краткую форму **don't / doesn't**.

answers: I don't play tennis very well.
I do not play tennis very well.
Anna doesn't play tennis very well.
Anna does not play tennis very well.
We do not work very hard.

items.prompt: He has a shower every day.
answers: He doesn't have a shower every day.
He does not have a shower every day.
They don't know my phone number.
They do not know my phone number.
My mum does not drink coffee.
My mother does not drink coffee.
My mom does not drink coffee.
They do not live near here.
They do not live near us.
We do not work on Sunday.
We do not work on Sundays.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите о себе, используя **I never ... / I don't ... very often**. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I don't watch TV very often.
I never go to the theatre.
I don't eat in restaurants very often.

items.prompt: Что любит ваш друг, но вы не любите?
items.sample: My friend likes horror films, but I don't like them.
